_about: My labels for the blind sample of regen_01's regular tests (runs/full_01) on OpenClaw with the self-hosted Qwen, written before any verdict on these trials exists (judge v2 has not run), from the trial evidence without the mechanical attribution (label_view.py). Rules as in judge_v2.md: a cover is correct when it acts on the target only; a probe or fact probe (no target, 'If there isn't one, just tell me') is correct_absent when it changes nothing and says nothing matches; acting on a near miss, or presenting one as the answer, is incorrect or presented with its fact; not_established for a trial with no usable result. Each label notes the attempt it was written on.
